name: Quantity Range 1 Choice
definition: Choice between ranges of values in which a quantity is considered valid or a specified quantity value which has to be matched or unmatched to be valid.

FromQuantity.name: From Quantity
FromQuantity.definition: Lower boundary of a range of quantity values.

ToQuantity.name: To Quantity
ToQuantity.definition: Upper boundary of a range of quantity values.

EqualQuantity.name: Equal Quantity
EqualQuantity.definition: Exact value a quantity must match to be considered valid.

NotEqualQuantity.name: Not Equal Quantity
NotEqualQuantity.definition: Value that a quantity must not match to be considered valid.
